request.description:
### Catalog Xpress Product Detail Page

This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information about a product from the catalog.

#### Request Body

- `storeCode` (string) - The code for the store.
    
- `latitude` (string) - The latitude coordinate.
    
- `longitude` (string) - The longitude coordinate.
    
- `districtId` (string) - The ID of the district.
    
- `mode` (string) - The mode of operation, e.g., "DELIVERY".
    
- `productId` (string) - The ID of the product.
    
- `plu` (string) - The mobile PLU.
    

#### Date-Time Variable Setting Process

The date-time variables such as `xpress_store_code`, `lat_terpilih`, `lon_terpilih`, `districtId_terpilih`, `xpress_productId`, and `xpress_mobile_plu` should be set with the appropriate values before making the request.

#### Response

The API returns a 400 status code with a JSON response containing the following fields:

- `status` (string) - The status of the response.
    
- `message` (string) - A descriptive message.
    
- `signature` (null) - The signature, if applicable.
    
- `data` (null) - The data related to the request.
    
- `timestamp` (string) - The timestamp of the response.
